controls.objective: Make cloud spend attributable to accountable teams, services, and environments.
controls.requirement: Cloud spend must be assigned to a service or cost owner using billing dimensions, account or project structure, and approved allocation rules. Unallocated and shared costs must be measured, reviewed, and reduced over time.
controls.risk: Unowned or poorly allocated spend hides waste, weakens forecasts, and makes engineering cost decisions difficult to defend.

controls.objective: Reduce avoidable spend without trading away required performance, resilience, or recovery capacity.
